To fix this, we need to modify the `System.out.println` statement to include spaces between `x`, `y`, and `z`.

Here is the patch:

# modification 1
```
<file>faultyVersion.java</file>
<original>
          if(x+y+z<=N)System.out.println(x+""+y+""+z);
</original>
<patched>
          if(x+y+z<=N)System.out.println(x + " " + y + " " + z);

```

This change ensures that the output format matches the expected format, with spaces between the integers in each triple.
